I didn't start in B2B marketing — I started by helping people learn.

My career began during the COVID-19 pandemic as an English tutor, where I discovered my passion for helping people grow. At the same time, I applied my digital marketing skills through Facebook Ads and LINE Official Account campaigns for local businesses.

This curiosity led me into marketing roles across different industries, from Account Management to MarTech and B2B marketing. Over the past four years, I have helped technology companies build growth engines through demand generation, marketing automation, CRM, SEO, partner marketing, and AI-powered workflows.

Today, I focus on turning marketing activities into measurable business impact — connecting campaigns, data, and customer experiences to create sustainable growth.

Outside of work, I enjoy building things, including an AI-native learning application, while learning Chinese as my third language to prepare for global collaboration.

If you're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking, data-driven decision-making, and hands-on execution to build sustainable growth, I'd love to connect.
